actual.titulo: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines • The Bernina Express
actual.descripcion: The Bernina Express ׀ A look at the Bernina Express, which fights its way from Switzerland to Italy over 196 bridges and 55 tunnels; the path leads it through deep valleys, wild gorges and over the eternal ice of the Graubünden Alps.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Barcode: How the Barcode Shaped Our Modern Economy
lista.descripcion: Barcode: How the Barcode Shaped Our Modern Economy ׀ Barcodes have radically changed global commerce, helping fuel the rise of everything from massive companies like Walmart to world powers like China, and it all started with a man daydreaming on a beach in 1949.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Florida: How Real Estate Rogues Invented Florida as We Know It
lista.descripcion: Florida: How Real Estate Rogues Invented Florida as We Know It ׀ Florida wasn't always the Sunshine State; in the 1920s, an army of real estate boosters set out to redefine Florida from an economic backwater to a ritzy vacation destination, sparking a land boom the likes of which America had never seen before.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Like Button: The Unintended Consenquences of the Facebook Like Button
lista.descripcion: Like Button: The Unintended Consenquences of the Facebook Like Button ׀ When first presented with the like button Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg worried that a quick thumbs up or down would discourage more meaningful online interaction but eventually his team changed his mind and transformed the world.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Cubicle: How the Cubicle Became Universally Hated
lista.descripcion: Cubicle: How the Cubicle Became Universally Hated ׀ The Cubicle was originally designed to set workers free; a futuristic designer named Robert Propst dreamed up the cubicle as a groovy 1960s workplace utopia that would unleash the modern knowledge worker's vast untapped potential.
Wasp Fighters ׀ Urged by their elders, two young Kayapos attack a nest of killer wasps.
Reindeer Hunters ׀ In the snow-covered mountains of Mongolia, Tsaatan Quizilol tries to capture reindeer to prove that he is man enough to marry his girlfriend.
The Honey Seekers ׀ At an altitude of 3,000 meters, Mopti climbs vertiginous rock faces of the Himalayas to gather honey from the biggest bee species on the planet: the giant Apis laboriosa bee.
Growing Up Hadza ׀ The Hadzabe of Tanzania, considered one of the last hunter-gatherer tribes on the planet, pass the knowledge of this way of life to the next generation.

lista.titulo: New Life: The Great Smoky Mountains
lista.descripcion: Two million visitors go to the Great Smoky Mountains National Park yearly; people come from all over the world to catch a glimpse of the blue haze that gives the park its name or a black bear scurrying into the woods.
